**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 21:10  
[FACT] User has completed a clay sculpture of their cat named Whiskers three weeks ago.  
[EVENT] User is looking for tips on how to properly care for and maintain their clay sculptures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended tips for caring for clay sculptures include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Dust regularly with a soft-bristled brush or dusting cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading, cracking, or brittleness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Maintain a consistent temperature between 65°F to 75°F (18°C to 24°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Handle with clean, dry hands to avoid marks or attracting dust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Avoid exposure to moisture and high humidity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Clean carefully with a soft, dry cloth or a mild soap solution for stubborn stains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Avoid extreme humidity changes to prevent cracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Support top-heavy or fragile sculptures with a sturdy base.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Monitor for pests that can damage the clay.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Consider varnishing or sealing for extra protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Store safely wrapped in acid-free paper or cloth in a sturdy box.  
[EVENT] User is planning to take a stone carving workshop soon.
